name: purchase-approvals
description: Monorepo root — convenience scripts only (no workspace tool). backend/, frontend/ and mobile/ are independent packages.

scripts.build:ci: pnpm -C backend run build && pnpm -C frontend/host run build && pnpm -C frontend/solicitante run build && pnpm -C frontend/aprobador run build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend/host test && pnpm -C frontend/solicitante test && pnpm -C frontend/aprobador test
scripts.dev:front: concurrently -k -n host,sol,apr "pnpm -C frontend/host start" "pnpm -C frontend/solicitante start" "pnpm -C frontend/aprobador start"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n back,front "pnpm run dev:back" "pnpm run dev:front"
